capabilities: Capture book metadata by scanning ISBN barcodes or searching by title and author
Fetch title, authors, publisher, year, page count, subjects, and cover image from Open Library and Google Books
Save book notes with YAML frontmatter and a personal notes section
Track condition grades, copy counts, valuation, and acquisition dates, with duplicate detection
Create and open a Bases catalog file with table views like All Books and By Year
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.8.0+ for Bases and desktop only; makes unauthenticated network requests to Open Library and Google Books but sends no vault data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog a physical book collection, fetch book metadata from ISBN or title lookups, or view the collection as a structured table.

relations.evidence: Open Library (Internet Archive) | ISBN lookup and title/author search | Every lookup and search
Google Books | ISBN lookup and title/author search (fallback) | When Open Library returns no results

summary: Book collection cataloger that scans ISBN barcodes or searches Open Library and Google Books to create metadata-rich book notes browsable in a Bases table.
